title: UE Niagara Authoring
description: Inspect and safely edit authored Niagara Systems, computation graphs, stack modules, node state, pin defaults, renderer materials, and typed inline User parameter defaults.

recipes.title: Inspect authored Niagara System state
recipes.description: Page deterministic emitter, renderer, and typed authored User parameter state without claiming component or runtime coverage.

inputs.name: system
inputs.description: Exact Niagara System package or object path.

inputs.name: emitter
inputs.description: Exact emitter handle ID or unambiguous display name for renderer detail.

inputs.name: rendererPath
inputs.description: Exact current renderer object path for material detail.

inputs.name: parameter
inputs.description: Exact existing User parameter name for typed detail.

steps.purpose: Read authored System settings, deterministic emitter and parameter pages, and outstanding compile state.
Read the renderer inventory, then exact renderer slots or an existing typed User parameter when requested.
Re-read the System inventory and report pagination, truncation, compile, authored-only, and runtime-unverified boundaries.

result.summary: Bounded authored Niagara state with explicit non-runtime scope.
evidence: renderer and typed User parameter pages
success: all pages and truncation were reported
authored state was not presented as component or runtime state

recipes.title: Inspect an authored Niagara graph
recipes.description: Read one current Niagara graph and page native computation operations without claiming runtime execution.

inputs.name: system
inputs.description: Exact Niagara System package or object path.

inputs.name: emitter
inputs.description: Exact emitter selector when inspecting an emitter graph.

inputs.name: graph
inputs.description: Exact current graph selector accepted by the live schema.

steps.purpose: Resolve the current System, emitter, graph, node paths, GUIDs, enabled states, and graph identity.
Page the graph's supported native computation operations and exact pin definitions.
Re-read the graph and report bounded, authored-only, compile, and runtime-unverified evidence.

result.summary: A bounded authored graph and operation catalog with stable current identities.
evidence: System, emitter, graph, node, and pin identities
success: the exact graph was resolved in the current Editor
pagination and authored-only scope were explicit
inventory was not presented as runtime execution proof

recipes.title: Add computation nodes and connections

inputs.name: system
inputs.description: Exact Niagara System package or object path.

inputs.name: graph
inputs.description: Exact owned graph selector.

inputs.name: nodes
inputs.description: Bounded node additions using operations returned by operations.list.

inputs.name: connections
inputs.description: Bounded additive pin connections between current or planned nodes.

steps.purpose: Read the exact graph and supported operation and pin definitions before constructing additions.
Validate on a transient copy, approve the current digest, and apply the additions once.
Read back the added structure and compilation state after the approved apply.
Remove only receipt-owned additions when rollback is requested and no graph drift exists.

result.summary: Approved additive computation-graph changes with structural, compile, and recovery evidence.
success: only supported additive operations were requested
the current plan was applied once
structure and compilation were verified or the owned additions were restored

inputs.description: Wait for bounded compiler completion; defaults to true.

steps.purpose: Read the filtered System inventory and current authored diagnostics before deciding whether fresh compilation is required.
Use the sole explicit compile request when fresh VM/GPU evidence is required, then query exact GPU HLSL if requested.
Read final bounded diagnostics and generated source with stale, truncation, renderer feedback, and emitter identity boundaries.
